specific_individual.description: Lexically selective individual classifiers retained in the core experiment.

broad_productive.description: General or broad human classifiers excluded because their high productivity contributes little lexical-selection evidence.

event_classifier.description: Classifiers of events, occurrences, rounds, repetitions or meals.

kind_classifier.description: Kind, type, model or variety classifiers.

collective_classifier.description: Collective, paired, grouped or set classifiers.

container_measure.description: Container-based measures rather than lexically selective individual classifiers.

approximate_or_standard_measure.description: Approximate quantities, partitives, statistical units or standard measures.

ordinal_naming_or_time.description: Numbering, generation, rank, tenure or time-period expressions.

polyfunctional.description: Forms that can act as an individual classifier in some contexts but as a measure, event or other construction in others.
